subject: general
question: Which DRDO-developed system, inducted into the Indian Army in 2024, played a crucial role in air defence during Operation Sindoor in 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Akashteer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Akashteer** is an advanced air defence system developed by **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation)** of India.
 
• It was inducted into the **Indian Army** in the year **2024** to strengthen the nation's air defence capabilities.
 
• Akashteer is specifically designed to counter aerial threats, including **fighter jets, helicopters, drones, and missiles.**
 
• The system played a crucial role in **Operation Sindoor** in **2025**, showcasing its effectiveness in neutralizing enemy aerial threats.
 
• It is equipped with advanced **radar technology** and **surface-to-air missiles (SAMs)** to ensure high precision and efficiency in targeting.
 
• The development of Akashteer represents India's focus on achieving **self-reliance** in defence technology under the **"Make in India"** initiative.
 
• This system is an evolution of the earlier **Akash** missile system, incorporating enhanced features and capabilities.
 
• Akashteer is a part of India's layered air defence system, providing a medium-range solution for protecting vital assets and locations.
 
• The system is mobile and can be deployed quickly, ensuring readiness for real-time threats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Barak-8**__

 __
 
• **Barak-8**, also known as the **LRSAM (Long Range Surface-to-Air Missile)**, is a joint development between **India and Israel**.
 
• It is designed to defend against **airborne threats** such as aircraft, helicopters, drones, and missiles.
 
• This system is primarily used by the **Indian Navy** for ship-based air defence.
 
 
 
• **Akash**__
 __
 
• **Akash** is an earlier version of the surface-to-air missile system developed by **DRDO**.
 
• It has a range of **25 km** and is used to target **medium-range aerial threats.**
 
• The Akash system has been deployed by both the **Indian Army** and the **Indian Air Force**.
 
 
 
• **QRSAM**__
 
 
• **QRSAM (Quick Reaction Surface-to-Air Missile)** is another air defence system developed by **DRDO.**
 
• It is designed for **short-range** engagements and has a range of **25-30 km.**
 
• QRSAM provides rapid deployment capability and is used to protect moving armoured formations.
